blocks.text: MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made at {{place}} on {{effective_date|date}} (the "Effective Date") between {{party_a_name}}, having its address at {{party_a_address}} ("First Party"), and {{party_b_name}}, having its address at {{party_b_address}} ("Second Party"). The First Party and the Second Party are together the "Parties" and each a "Party".
1. Purpose
The Parties wish to share confidential information for the purpose of {{purpose}} (the "Purpose").
2. Confidential Information

"Confidential Information" means all non-public information, in any form, that one Party (the "Discloser") gives to the other (the "Recipient") for the Purpose and that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential.
3. Obligations

The Recipient shall (a) use Confidential Information only for the Purpose; (b) not disclose it to any person other than its employees, advisers and representatives who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound to keep it confidential; and (c) protect it with at least the care it uses for its own confidential information.
4. Exclusions

These obligations do not apply to information that (a) is or becomes public other than through breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to the Recipient before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidence; or (d) is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information if required by law or by a court, after giving the Discloser prompt notice where the law allows.
5. Term

This Agreement binds the Parties for {{term_years}} years from the Effective Date. The duty of confidentiality for information disclosed during that time continues for the same number of years after the date of disclosure.
6. Return of information
On written request, the Recipient shall promptly return or destroy the Discloser's Confidential Information and confirm in writing that it has done so, except for copies it must keep by law.
7. No licence
Nothing in this Agreement gives either Party any right, title or licence in the other Party's Confidential Information or intellectual property.
8. Remedies

Each Party acknowledges that breach of this Agreement may cause harm for which damages alone may not be enough, and that the Discloser may seek injunctive relief in addition to any other remedy available in law.
9. Lawful trade
Nothing in this Agreement restrains any person from engaging in a lawful profession, trade or business, in accordance with Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872.
10. Governing law and jurisdiction
This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. The courts at {{jurisdiction_city}} have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from it.
The Parties have signed this Agreement on the date first written above.
